definitions.explanation: Something kept from public knowledge or shared only with select people, often in a professional or personal context.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内密|ないみつ}にして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{内密|ないみつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have something private to discuss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{内密|ないみつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received a confidential consultation from my boss.

notes:
Used to describe information or matters that should not be disclosed to others. Functions as both a noun and a na-adjective. Common in business and formal contexts when discussing sensitive information.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内密|ないみつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to keep confidential
- {内密|ないみつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: a private conversation
- {内密|ないみつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to handle discreetly
- {内密|ないみつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to proceed in secret

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧: secret — broader and more common, used for everything from personal secrets to classified information, while {内密|ないみつ} has a more formal, discreet nuance and implies keeping something within a trusted circle
- ⟦{極秘|ごくひ}→極秘：13162_gokuhi⟧: top secret — much stronger than {内密|ないみつ}, implying the highest level of confidentiality
